snippet: You have successfully activated your Way2Go debit card with your PIN  selection. If you did not activate your card by setting the initial PIN,  please contact the Way2Go Customer Service at the phone number on the back  of your card immediately.

subject: Replacement for your Way2Go Card
snippet: ZAIN KHAN,   We have sent your new Way2Go Card. Depending on the time and day your card  was shipped to you, it may take up to several days for tracking information  to be available.   This is an automated email message from the Way2Go Card help desk. Please  do not reply to this email.
